content:
探囊取物 / Su's Instant Swap

一鍵交換手中物品，無需打開物品欄拖放，省時省力。

One key, instant item swap. No more opening inventory and dragging items with the mouse.

使用方式 / How to use

你可以使用兩種方式快速將物品欄中的物品交換到手上，或者直接將一整行物品換到快捷欄中
You can use one of two methods to quickly swap an item from your hotbar/inventory into your hand, or directly swap an entire row of items into your hotbar.

一鍵交換模式：

Instant swap mode:

  1. 按住 E 鍵（跟隨原版的開關物品欄按鍵）
    Hold the E key (the vanilla inventory key)

  2. 物品欄介面出現（如此時放開按鍵，介面將關閉）
    The inventory panel appears (if you release the key now, the panel closes)

  3. 滑鼠懸停在目標物品，或者目標行邊上的綠色標記上
    Hover your mouse over the desired item, or the green marker next to the target row

  4. 放開 E 鍵執行交換，物品欄自動關閉
    Release the E key to perform the swap, the panel closes automatically

介面內交換模式：

In‑GUI swap mode:

  1. 在物品欄或其他儲存介面中（理論上兼容其他模組）
    In the inventory or other storage GUI (theoretically compatible with other mods)

  2. 滑鼠懸停在目標物品，或者目標行邊上的綠色標記上
    Hover your mouse over the desired item, or the green marker next to the target row

  3. 短按 左Alt 鍵（可自訂）執行交換，物品欄自動關閉
    Tap the Left Alt key (customizable) to perform the swap, the panel closes automatically

背包模組支援 / Backpack Mod Support

此外，從 3.0.0 版本起，新增了對部分熱門背包模組的支援，例如使用精妙背包模組時，長按 B 鍵（預設的打開背包按鍵）也可以在背包 UI 內進行交換。下面是目前已支援的背包模組：

Additionally, since version 3.0.0, support for some popular backpack mods has been added. For example, when using Sophisticated Backpacks, long-pressing the B key (the default backpack open key) also allows swapping inside the backpack UI. Below is the list of currently supported backpack mods:

  • Sophisticated Backpacks
  • Traveler's Backpack
  • Backpacked
  • Inmis
  • Simply Backpacks
  • Packed Up
  • L2 Backpack
  • Beans Backpacks
  • Resource Backpacks

按鍵設定 / Keybinding

即時交換按鍵自動綁定為開關物品欄按鍵。
The instant swap key is automatically bound to the vanilla inventory key.

介面內交換按鍵預設為左 Alt 鍵，可自行修改。
The in‑GUI swap key defaults to Left Alt and can be changed separately.

設定檔 / Configuration

你可以在遊戲內模組設定中修改下列內容（Fabric 版需要 Mod Menu，否則需自行到 config 資料夾中修改）：
You can change the following options in the in‑game mod configuration (Fabric version requires Mod Menu; otherwise edit the config file directly in the config folder):

  1. 模組開關 – 若關閉，則模組完全停用。預設開啟。
    Mod toggle – If disabled, the whole mod is turned off. Default: ON.

  2. 長按判定閾值 – 用於區分長按和短按，可設定為 50-1000 毫秒。預設 200 毫秒。
    Long press threshold – Used to distinguish between long and short presses, adjustable from 50 to 1000 ms. Default: 200 ms.

  3. 交換音效 – 用於開關交換物品的音效。預設開啟。
    Swap sound – Enable/disable the sound when swapping items. Default: ON.

  4. 滑鼠重新定位 – 在打開物品欄介面時，滑鼠會自動移動到 UI 右下角避免遮擋。我非常希望大家嘗試這個功能，所以預設開啟，如果你不適應的話可以手動關閉。
    Mouse reposition – When opening the inventory panel, the mouse automatically moves to the bottom‑right corner to avoid blocking the view. I highly recommend trying this feature, so it is enabled by default; you can turn it off if you are not comfortable with it.

  5. 快捷欄優先 – 開啟後，如果你的快捷欄中還有空位，被換下來的物品會優先放入快捷欄，對於建築等需要反覆使用不同方塊的場景有些幫助。我很希望大家嘗試這個功能，但是可能會造成一些反直覺的誤解，所以預設關閉。
    Hotbar priority – When enabled, if you have empty slots in your hotbar, the swapped‑out item will be placed into the hotbar first. This can be helpful for building or other scenarios where you frequently switch between different blocks. I highly encourage trying it out, but it may cause some counter‑intuitive confusion, so it is disabled by default.

  6. 介面內交換 – 若關閉，則無法在物品欄介面內按鍵交換物品。預設關閉（防止誤觸）。
    Swap inside GUI – If disabled, you cannot swap by pressing the key while the inventory panel is open. Default: OFF (prevents accidental swaps).

  7. 空位交換 – 開啟後，允許和空位進行交換。預設關閉。
    Swap with empty slots – When enabled, allows swapping with empty slots. Default: OFF.

  8. 整行交換 – 關閉後將停用整行交換的 UI 和功能。預設開啟。
    Row swap – If disabled, the row swap UI and functionality are turned off. Default: ON.

  9. 交換失敗通知 – 開啟時，會在交換失敗時顯示提示文字。預設開啟。
    Swap failure notification – When enabled, shows a message when a swap fails. Default: ON.

  10. 除錯日誌 – 開啟後將在遊戲日誌檔案中產生除錯資訊，若使用模組時遇到問題，可以打開這個選項，並將遊戲的 latest.log 提供給模組作者。預設關閉。
    Debug logging – When enabled, generates debug information in the game log file. If you encounter issues with the mod, turn this on and provide the latest.log file to the mod author. Default: OFF.

其他說明 / Additional Info

*非常推薦和 InvMove 一起使用，打開物品欄將不會影響你的行走，體驗更順暢。
Highly recommended to use together with InvMove – opening the inventory will not affect your movement, for a smoother experience.

*模組為純客戶端，可在未安裝該模組的伺服器上使用，但請務必與服主確認，自行承擔反作弊風險。
Pure client‑side mod – works on servers without the mod, but always check with your server admin. Use at your own risk regarding anti‑cheat.

*模組完全由 AI 開發，若遇到 BUG，請到 GitHub 提交問題。
Developed entirely by AI. Please report bugs on GitHub.

*開源協議：LGPL 3.0
License: LGPL 3.0
